games.title: Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree
games.tagline: A towering dark-fantasy expansion that rivals standalone RPGs in scale and ambition.
games.summary: Venture into the Realm of Shadow, a sprawling new land veiled from the Lands Between. Follow Miquella's footsteps across vertical legacy dungeons, haunted ruins, and unforgettable boss encounters that push FromSoftware's combat design to its sharpest edge.
pros: Dense, vertically layered map packed with secrets
Some of FromSoftware's most inventive boss fights
New weapon classes meaningfully refresh builds
cons: Late-game difficulty spikes can feel punishing
Occasional frame pacing dips in particle-heavy fights

reviews.author: Alex Mercer
reviews.headline: A masterclass in world design disguised as DLC
reviews.body: Every time I thought I had reached the edge of the map, another hidden path dropped me into an entirely new biome. Messmer's keep alone is worth the price of admission.

reviews.author: Samira Chen
reviews.headline: Unforgiving, gorgeous, and endlessly rewarding
reviews.body: Scadutree Blessings encourage thorough exploration before tackling major bosses. Once the rhythm clicked, it delivered my favorite 40 hours of the year.

games.title: Baldur's Gate 3
games.tagline: A generational CRPG where nearly every choice reshapes the story and combat.
games.summary: Gather your party and return to the Forgotten Realms in a tale of fellowship and betrayal, sacrifice and survival, and the lure of absolute power. Built on Dungeons & Dragons 5th Edition rules, it reacts to your creativity at every turn.
pros: Unmatched narrative reactivity and player freedom
Tactical turn-based combat brimming with environmental combos
cons: Steep learning curve for newcomers to D&D rules

reviews.author: Jordan Vance
reviews.headline: Sets a new gold standard for role-playing games
reviews.body: Three playthroughs in and I am still discovering entire questlines and dialogue branches I never knew existed. Nothing else comes close to this level of reactivity.

games.title: Hades II
games.tagline: Bewitching roguelike action with razor-sharp combat and deep mythic charm.
games.summary: Play as Melinoe, immortal Princess of the Underworld, wielding dark sorcery and Nocturnal Arms to confront the Titan of Time. Dual surface and underworld routes double the variety of every run.
pros: Fluid magick-infused combat and Omega moves
Two distinct multi-biome routes with unique bosses
Gorgeous hand-painted art and Darren Korb's soundtrack
cons: Resource gathering can feel grindy early on
Some Arcana card synergies overshadow others

reviews.author: Maya Patel
reviews.headline: Runs like a dream and hooks you for 'just one more run'
reviews.body: Charging Casts and Omega attacks changes the pacing completely from the first game in the best way. The surface route is an incredible surprise.

games.title: Astro Bot
games.tagline: Pure platforming joy overflowing with tactile DualSense magic.
games.summary: Jet across more than 50 vibrant planets to reunite Astro's scattered crew. Every stage introduces a fresh power-up, clever physics toy, and nostalgic PlayStation cameo without ever outstaying its welcome.
pros: Unrivaled haptic feedback and controller creativity
Zero filler — every level has a distinct hook
Delightful visual gags and secret challenge stages
